changes.evidence: Mole Man (Harvey Elder) appears only in The Fantastic Four: First Steps, set on Earth-828; his hero twin A:harvey-elder already carries Earth-828.

Defender Strange is the Sorcerer Supreme of another universe in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, not of Earth-199999. Marvel Database files him as Stephen Strange (Earth-TRN953). The MCU Wiki calls it Earth-617.
In Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness he is the Sorcerer Supreme of his world's Masters of the Mystic Arts. The MCU Wiki lists his affiliation as Masters of the Mystic Arts (Earth-617).

In Deadpool & Wolverine, Dogpool (Mary Puppins) is a variant pruned to the Void from another reality, who ends up living on Earth-10005 with Wade. She is not from Earth-199999. Marvel Database files her as Mary Puppins (Earth-TRN872): reality unknown, now displaced to Earth-10005.
In Thor (end-credits scene), Fury brings Selvig in to study the Tesseract for S.H.I.E.L.D., which recruits him to Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. The record's own Thor step says he agrees to it there.

Ross's Air Force service is backstory. In Black Panther, Shuri calls him a 'former Air Force pilot, now CIA', so he is not in the Air Force from Black Panther on. He joined the CIA after leaving the Air Force, before Civil War.

owner_calls.question: In Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, CIA Director Valentina has Ross arrested for treason, and Okoye's team breaks him out. Is that a departure from the CIA (add a left at Wakanda Forever)?
options: Add left: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
Keep CIA as his last stage
owner_calls.evidence: Arrested for passing U.S. plans to Ramonda, then broken out of custody as a fugitive. The MCU Wiki lists CIA as 'formerly'. Secret Invasion only shows him freed from a Skrull prison and never shows his job.
